manifest.viewsContainers.dinah.title: Dinah
manifest.views.dinah.workbenchView.name: Workbench
manifest.viewsWelcome.binaryMissing.cont:
Dinah is not installed on this machine. This extension is a companion to the `dinah` command-line tool, and it does not carry a copy of it. Install dinah from [github.com/paulmooreparks/dinah#install](https://github.com/paulmooreparks/dinah#install), or set `dinah.path` to a binary you already have.
[Open the Dinah settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%22dinah%22)
manifest.viewsWelcome.workbenchNone.cont:
No workbench was found from this folder.

To start one here, run `dinah init` in a terminal. To use one you already have, set `dinah.workbench` to its directory.

New to Dinah? [Walk through your first session](command:workbench.action.openWalkthrough?%22paulmooreparks.dinah%23dinah.firstSession%22)
[Open the Dinah settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%22dinah%22)
manifest.viewsWelcome.workbenchAmbiguous:
Several workbenches are reachable from here. Set `dinah.workbench` to the one you mean.
[Open the Dinah settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%22dinah%22)
manifest.viewsWelcome.workbenchUnknown.c:
Dinah has a binary for this window but no workbench to go with it. Open a folder to work from, or open the Dinah output channel to read what `dinah` reported.
[Open the Dinah settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%22dinah%22)
manifest.viewsWelcome.workbenchSearching:
Dinah found a binary for this window and is still looking for a workbench.

This text is replaced as soon as Dinah has an answer. If it stays, open the Dinah output channel to see what happened.
manifest.viewsWelcome.binarySearching.co:
Looking for a dinah binary and a workbench.

This text is replaced as soon as the extension has an answer. If it stays, open the Dinah output channel to see what happened.

manifest.configuration.title: Dinah
manifest.configuration.dinah.path.markdo: Absolute path to the `dinah` binary. Leave empty to use the one on your PATH. A binary path is a property of the machine, so this setting does not travel through settings sync.
manifest.configuration.dinah.workbench.m: Directory of the workbench to use for this folder, passed to `dinah` as `--workbench`. Leave empty to let `dinah` discover one by walking up from the folder. Set it when several workbenches are reachable, or when the walk reaches one you did not mean.
manifest.configuration.dinah.pollInterva: How often the sidebar tree checks `dinah changes` for updates while visible.
Watch the workbench's Markdown files for changes and check sooner than the poll interval when one is saved.
manifest.walkthrough.firstSession.title: Dinah: Your First Session
manifest.walkthrough.firstSession.descri: Get oriented at a Dinah workbench, using Dinah's own guide.
manifest.walkthrough.firstSession.step.r:
This step opens `dinah guide first-session` in an editor tab, fetched live from your installed binary. The text always matches what the command prints, because nothing here copies it.

[Open the guide](command:dinah.walkthrough.openFirstSessionGuide)
